kyoto_kakyo_jingumichi.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses only, of seasonal kaiseki with French touches built on Japanese dashi (official site; 2017–2018 reviews); no gluten or allergy information on the official site.
kyoto_kakyo_jingumichi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dishes are built on Japanese dashi (2017–2019 reviews), and courses include sashimi, crab, soft roe, fish and meat (2018–2025 reviews); no vegan course mentioned.
kyoto_kakyo_jingumichi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 20:00) (official site; Tabelog gives lunch until 15:30). Closed Mondays, but open on Mondays for special reservations; check the online booking calendar for closing days (Tabelog); the official site lists closing days as irregular. Omakase courses only; reservation needed (official site, English page); online booking on TableCheck or by phone (official site). Prices include tax and service charge (official site); Tabelog lists a 10% service charge. Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX); no e-money (Tabelog). Seats: 7 at the counter and 9 at two tables (up to 14); private hire for 10 or more adults (official site); Tabelog gives 16 seats. Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; no parking (Tabelog). Ground floor of Schilf Jingu-michi on Sanjo, east of Jingu-michi: 2 min from the Sanjo Jingu-michi city bus stop, 6 min walk from Higashiyama or Keage Stn (Tabelog). Opened 4 February 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kakyo_jingumichi.notes: [Kaiseki · Sanjo Jingu-michi] A sixteen-seat counter and table restaurant on the Okazaki side of Sanjo, run since 2017 by an owner-chef who is also a senior sommelier and sake sommelier: seasonal kaiseki with French touches, ¥10,000–16,000 at lunch and ¥18,000–30,000 at dinner, with sake, wine or non-alcoholic pairings. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: The owner, 中上朝史 (ちゅうじょう ともひと, official site; Chujo Tomohito on the English site), is a cook, a sake sommelier (kikizakeshi, 1997) and a senior sommelier (2012), and holds grade 2 of the Kyoto Kentei, taken in 2010 so as to introduce Kyoto's culture and history to the many visitors (official site). A November 2017 reviewer wrote that the chef had worked under another chef before opening this place. The name comes from 花鏡, the treatise in which Zeami, who spread Noh in Kyoto about 600 years ago, gathered a theory of the art; the owner took it for its best-known saying, 「初心忘るべからず」 (never forget the beginner's spirit) (official site). Opened 4 February 2017 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: The official site: original, individual new Japanese cuisine served with wine, sake, house-made juices and blended teas; omakase only, so each plate's seasoning and presentation can give the course its rhythm.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki with French touches; drink pairings chosen by the owner.

anecdotes.text: A diner from Tokyo who returned again and again between November 2017 and April 2019 had already booked December on the November 2017 visit; the omakase drinks began with a sparkling sake, light enough for those who seldom drink.
In March 2025 a diner called for a next-day lunch, got no answer and hung up, then was surprised by a return call and a seat at the ¥7,000 lunch.

A couple celebrating their wedding anniversary in March 2026 had the ¥20,000 course with five Hinamatsuri-themed appetizers; the reviewer noticed a slight fishy smell in some dishes and, too full by the end, would have liked a lighter bamboo shoot rice without fish.
Three friends at lunch in December 2025 enjoyed the different coloured plates and unusual presentation as much as the food.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: kakyo 花鏡 (かきょう)。京都 三条神宮道。四季折々の懐石料理にフレンチのテイストが入った料理と、ワイン、日本酒のマリアージュ。店主 中上朝史 (ちゅうじょう ともひと)、利酒師 (1997年取得)、シニアソムリエ (2012年取得)、京都検定2級 (2010年取得)。独創性 (個性) のある新しい日本料理を、ワインや日本酒、手作りジュースや各種ブレンド茶とともに。屋号は世阿弥が能芸論を集大成した本から、「初心忘るべからず」。おまかせコースのみ: ランチ10,000円・13,000円・16,000円、ディナー18,000円・24,000円・30,000円 (税・サービス料込)、お酒のペアリング5〜8杯6,500〜10,000円 (ハーフ5,000〜8,000円)、ノンアルコールペアリング5〜6杯4,000〜5,000円。ランチ12時〜15時 (L.O.13時30分)、ディナー18時〜22時30分 (L.O.20時)、不定休、カウンター7席、テーブル2卓9席 (14席まで)、大人10名以上で貸切。食べログ (店舗の公式情報): 東山区中之町203 schilf神宮道 1F、月曜休み (特別な予約で営業)、サービス料10%、16席、2017年2月4日オープン。口コミ (2017〜2026年、英語): 日本のだしとフレンチ、パティシエのデザート、ランチ7,000円 (2023年、2025年)、20,000円のコース (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English and French versions of the official site; the owner took the Kyoto Kentei to introduce Kyoto to visitors (official site). Phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

kyoto_izuyasu_higashihonganji.gf_detail: Ask. Tea-style kaiseki whose menu changes daily (official site; March 2026 review); no gluten information. The inn asks for allergies and dislikes in advance and may not manage them on the day (official site).
kyoto_izuyasu_higashihonganji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki with fish, beef and dashi-based soups (March 2026 review); no vegan menu mentioned.
kyoto_izuyasu_higashihonganji.hours_raw: Dining without a stay is welcome (official site; Tabelog). By reservation only (Tabelog). Dinner: one kaiseki course, everyone starts at 19:00 (official site); Tabelog lists 19:00–21:00 on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays and public holidays, closed Sundays and one weekday (Wednesday in the timetable), and closed on a Monday that is a public holiday. Lunch: a shokado box or the kaiseki course, the course starting at 12:00 (official site); the site does not say which days lunch is served. Breakfast of Kyoto obanzai ¥1,870 is also on the menu page (official site). Prices include tax and service charge (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats; a counter, tables for groups, a hall and private rooms for 2 to 20 people; private use up to 20 (official site; Tabelog). Non-smoking; parking for 3 cars, by reservation (Tabelog). Just by Higashi Honganji, 10 min walk from JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog; March 2026 review).
kyoto_izuyasu_higashihonganji.notes: [Kaiseki · Kyoto Station] A restaurant-inn founded in 1839 at the gate of Higashi Honganji, where the seventh-generation owner, a tea practitioner, cooks kaiseki for each of the 24 solar terms — ¥15,400 at dinner (all guests at 19:00) or a ¥6,050 shokado lunch — for diners as well as overnight guests, among the inn's scrolls, art and Edo-period festival dolls. Reservation only.

chef_bio.background: Opened in 1839 (Tenpo 10) as a restaurant and inn in the temple town of Higashi Honganji, serving monks and pilgrims and later travellers and business guests; the woodblock artist 棟方志功 stayed for several months late in life while making the fusuma paintings for Higashi Honganji's Shoseien (official site). The front lattice and the lantern garden are almost as they were at the founding; one lantern in the garden survived the great fire of the Onin War; a renovation in 2013 added a library lounge, 「京都本箱」 (official site). The seventh-generation head, who signs the greeting 井筒安次郎, is the cook and a tea practitioner who has taken part in tea gatherings through the seasons (official site); Tabelog's shop text links the owner to the Omotesenke school of tea. Art handed down over seven generations, including works by 伊藤若冲, 小野竹喬 and 稲葉心田, and Edo-period hina and May dolls set out for the festivals (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: The greeting on the official site: to keep things unchanged one must keep changing; tradition is adding one more layer to what earlier generations built. Service is held back a little so guests can keep their own pace (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki for the 24 solar terms; shokado lunch.

anecdotes.text: In March 2026, near the Doll Festival, a diner was shown the inn's carefully kept hina doll display and listened to the seventh-generation owner's stories over a course that ended with sea bream rice.
A January 2026 diner was offered a look at the historic rooms upstairs after the meal.
A guest who stayed in October 2021 found it quiet for somewhere so near Kyoto Station, with seasonal flowers and art throughout and none of the stiffness of a luxury inn.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 料理旅宿 井筒安、天保10年 (1839年) 創業、東本願寺の門前町で料理屋、旅籠屋として始まる。棟方志功が晩年に東本願寺渉成園の襖絵のために数ヶ月逗留。二十四節気に即した懐石、腕をふるうのは料理人である七代目主人 (茶人)。カウンター、テーブル席、広間、個室、お食事だけの利用も可能 (会食、結納、法事、節句の祝い)。京都産を中心とした日本酒、ワインは常時数十種。夕食: 懐石コース15,400円 (19時から一斉)。昼食: 松花堂ランチ6,050円、懐石コース15,400円 (12時から)。朝食1,870円。消費税・サービス料込。アレルギーは事前に。伊藤若冲、小野竹喬、稲葉心田の作品、江戸時代の雛人形や五月人形。2013年の改装でライブラリー「京都本箱」。応仁の乱の大火をくぐり抜けた傘灯篭。七代目当主 井筒安次郎。下京区笹屋町272。食べログ: 完全予約制、19:00〜21:00、日曜と平日1日休み、20席、個室2〜20名、駐車場3台、カード可。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 二十四節気の懐石、雛人形、2階の部屋。

cultural_comfort.note: English version of the official site, which invites diners who are not staying. Phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

kyoto_okonomiyaki_yokoyama_nijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-batter okonomiyaki and negiyaki, yakisoba and teppanyaki with a house sauce (Tabelog; 2019–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_okonomiyaki_yokoyama_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki with pork and egg, beef tendon, clams, scallops and Wagyu on the griddle (Tabelog; 2019–2026 reviews); no vegan option mentioned.
kyoto_okonomiyaki_yokoyama_nijo.hours_raw: Tue–Thu 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); Fri and Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); Sun and public holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog, official information; the timetable heading reads "Mon–Thu" but Mondays are given as closed). Reservations taken (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). A ¥390 starter is served and a drink order is required (September 2024 review). 18 seats, 6 at the counter, and a semi-private room for six where children are welcome; babies and strollers welcome; takeaway; English menu (Tabelog). Non-smoking; paid parking in front (Tabelog). In a 100-year-old townhouse in a residential street between Nijo Castle and Karasuma-Oike, 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2024 review). Opened 17 October 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_okonomiyaki_yokoyama_nijo.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nijo] A teppanyaki and okonomiyaki bar in a 100-year-old townhouse by Nijo Castle: Kyoto-style okonomiyaki in a house sauce, yakisoba, beef tendon and the house negiyaki of Kujo green onions and clams, at ¥4,000–5,000 a head, under walls of signed celebrity posters. Evenings only; no cards; closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 17 October 2017 in a 100-year-old townhouse (Tabelog, official information). In November 2023 two women, perhaps the owners according to the reviewer, chatted with the guests; a November 2024 review describes the shop as run by a beautiful proprietress whose skill and house sauce explain the ratings. The walls are covered in signed posters of famous visitors (September 2024, April 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: はんなり焼き (negiyaki of Kujo green onions and clams); okonomiyaki in the house sauce; yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: Looking for sweets on a second stop in November 2023, two friends found the sweets long gone but stayed for teppanyaki; the menu joked "beautiful smiles — free, beautiful service — market price". The reviewer found the prices high for the area, the portions small and the house negiyaki ordinary.
A September 2024 diner out with a colleague was surprised by the signed posters on the walls and took the staff's advice to add garlic to the yakisoba.
After the evening light-up at Nijo Castle in April 2025 a diner found it a little pricey but loved the tomato with fluffy egg.
A January 2026 passer-by who stopped in on a whim found the owner kind and very friendly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗の公式情報): よこやま、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・甘味処、中京区二条西洞院町632、二条城前駅から徒歩3分、火〜木 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、金土 17:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、日祝 17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR可、18席 (カウンター6席)、6名の半個室、子ども可、テイクアウト、英語メニュー、禁煙、2017年10月17日オープン。築100年の町家、こだわりの食材の鉄板焼き、A5の和牛ステーキ、特製ソースの京風お好み焼き、老舗の製麺所の麺の焼きそば。口コミ (2019〜2026年): はんなり焼き (九条ねぎ、あさり、新しょうが、薄口しょうゆ) 1,100円、すじ肉焼き1,320円、焼きそば950円、豚玉1,100円、お通し390円とワンドリンク (2024年9月)、焼きそばミックス、お好み焼きミックス、鳥タレ焼き、れんこんチーズ、トマトとふんわり卵、豆腐焼き、こんにゃく刺し (2019年8月)、壁に有名人のサイン。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu available (Tabelog); a chatty, friendly counter (November 2023 and January 2026 reviews). Phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated through January 2026.

kyoto_french_cafe_chasen_kodaiji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pizzas, pastas, matcha tiramisu and the macaron-style 茶カロ cakes are the core of the menu (reviews; Kyoto Kurasu, November 2024). No gluten information is published.
kyoto_french_cafe_chasen_kodaiji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the matcha sweets use cream, ice cream and tiramisu (reviews), and the meals include fried chicken and Saikyo-grilled fish. A vegetable pizza was served with a little cheese (November 2025). No vegan information is published.
kyoto_french_cafe_chasen_kodaiji.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00 (Tabelog). Two 2024 articles give 11:00–21:30 (last order 20:30), closing days not fixed (japan-style.jp, April 2024; Kyoto Kurasu, November 2024). Tabelog says no reservations; a June 2025 reviewer says bookings can be made by phone. Cards (AMEX), e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 50 seats (Tabelog): 7 counter seats by the entrance and about 40 table seats further in, the window seats the most popular (Kyoto Kurasu, November 2024). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Orders by QR code (May 2025 review). Next to a souvenir shop by the Kodaiji parking lot; the paid Kodaiji car park is next door (Tabelog; May 2025 review). The way up is through the parking lot and up some stairs (December 2025 review). Opened 4 October 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_french_cafe_chasen_kodaiji.notes: [Café · Kodaiji, matcha sweets with a view] A large café beside the Kodaiji parking lot, with windows over the Higashiyama rooftops and the Yasaka Pagoda: the smoking paulownia "treasure box" of matcha sweets (¥1,980), matcha parfaits and tiramisu, plus pizzas, pastas and set meals, open to 21:00. Part of the small Chasen matcha-sweets brand. Orders by QR code; cards accepted.

roles: Operator: 株式会社フーズフロンティア (brand site)
chef_bio.background: The brand site of 茶筅 -Chasen- names the operating company 株式会社フーズフロンティア, with the representative 山崎 富紀 and an office in Kamigyo Ward, Kyoto, and lists one shop, at the Kyoto Station Building 10th floor in the ramen alley (brand site, undated). A 2024 article calls French cafe CHASEN 高台寺 the third shop of 茶筅, known for its matcha treasure box (japan-style.jp, April 2024). An undated blog whose title marks the Kyoto Station 茶筅 as closed says the shop is run by 株式会社フーズフロンティア and that 茶筅 also has a shop in Kumamoto (ameblo). The brand site says the matcha tiramisu uses matcha from 吉田銘茶園 of Uji. Tabelog notes that the premises were until recently a coffee shop. Opened 4 October 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: お抹茶玉手箱スイーツ (matcha treasure box); matcha parfait and tiramisu.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor opened the treasure box to a cloud of steam like a sea of clouds, and found the café surprisingly uncrowded at 15:00 on a holiday, as if few people know it is there.
A December 2025 diner found the way in tricky, up through the Kodaiji parking lot and a flight of stairs, but the stairs gave a sweeping view of the Yasaka Pagoda and even Kyoto Station.
In May 2025 a diner ordered a pasta by QR code and found it good, but not served piping hot, so it cooled while eating.
A May 2026 diner came back for a late weekday lunch with a daughter, had pasta and a Saikyo-grilled fish set, and finished with the dry-ice treasure box of matcha parfait and tiramisu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ブランドサイト (茶筅 -Chasen-、会社概要): 店舗名 茶筅 -Chasen-、運営会社名 株式会社フーズフロンティア、代表者名 山崎 富紀、京都府京都市上京区の所在地、店舗紹介は京都駅ビル10F 京都拉麺小路内の1店舗のみ、お抹茶ティラミスに宇治の吉田銘茶園の抹茶。japan-style.jp (2024年4月): お抹茶玉手箱で話題の「茶筅」の3号店、高台寺境内、大きな窓から八坂の塔、11:00〜21:30 (L.O.20:30)、不定休。京都くらす (2024年11月): お抹茶玉手箱スイーツ1,980円、茶カロ9種類 (レモンクリーム418円、抹茶モンブラン506円)、入口近くにカウンター7席、奥に約40席のテーブル席、二寧坂など東山の景色が見える窓際の席が人気。ブログ (ameblo、日付なし): 京都駅の茶筅は閉店と表記、株式会社フーズフロンティアが運営、熊本にも店舗。食べログ (英語版): カフェ、フレンチ、予約不可、毎日11:00〜21:00、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QRコード決済可、50席、全席禁煙、隣に高台寺の有料駐車場、オープン日2021年10月4日。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): QRコードで注文 (2025年5月)、玉手箱スイーツ1,980円 (2025年6月)、駐車場から階段を上る、八坂の塔の眺め (2025年12月)、ドライアイスの玉手箱 (2026年5月、6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Orders by QR code (May 2025); no English menu or English-speaking staff mentioned in any source.

kyoto_ageru_shinkamanza.gf_detail: Ask. Fried dishes, a pork tenderloin katsu sandwich, pastas and a blue-cheese rusk are wheat-based; steak, ceviche and salads are on the menu too, but no gluten information is published (official page; reviews).
kyoto_ageru_shinkamanza.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a menu built on beef, pork, shrimp, tuna, whitebait and cheese (official page; reviews). Fried potatoes, corn and Kamo eggplant appear, but no vegan information is published.
kyoto_ageru_shinkamanza.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00, holidays included (Tabelog; operator’s page). Closing days not fixed (operator’s page). Reservations taken (Tabelog); booked out every day soon after opening (June 2026 review), but a weekday booking a week ahead was easy (July 2026) and an early weekday walk-in found a table (September 2026). Cash, cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR payments (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay) (Tabelog; operator’s page). 34 seats: 12 at the counter and 22 at tables (Tabelog; operator’s page); counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs (June and July 2026 reviews). English menu (Tabelog). Smoking policy not stated. No parking. About 5 minutes from Hankyu Karasuma and subway Shijo stations (Tabelog). Opened 11 June 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ageru_shinkamanza.notes: [Western · Shijo-Karasuma, wine bistro in a renovated house] A two-floor Western wine bistro opened in June 2026 in a renovated house on a stone-paved lane: akaushi tagliata, kombu-cured shrimp ceviche, a wagyu hamburg steak, the much-praised pork tenderloin katsu sandwich, fried vegetables and wines from classic to natural. Counter downstairs, tables upstairs; open to 23:00. Booking advised; English menu.

chef_bio.background: The operator’s site says 株式会社Atari proposes new kinds of Kyoto-rooted sakaba and lists four shops: 酒呑気びんご, the neo-bistro 六角ace, 酒ﾉみつぼし and ageru. (kyoto-atari.co). Two of them are already in this app: 酒呑気 びんご (kyoto_sakenonki_bingo) and 酒ノみつぼし (kyoto_sake_no_mitsuboshi), whose records cite the same four-shop list. Reviewers call ageru. the group’s fourth shop and its first Western-food sakaba (June 2026). A June 2026 diner found the clientele mostly young women and the young staff lively and keen; a July 2026 diner found the staff kind and the restaurant and restrooms spotless.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients chosen from all over Japan, turned into Western dishes with a twist, paired with wine (operator’s page).
chef_bio.specialty: Pork tenderloin katsu sandwich; akaushi tagliata; wagyu and Satsuma pork hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner asked the staff what to order next and was steered to the aged Hokkaido potatoes, crisp outside and fluffy inside; the tagliata had sold out that day.
An August 2026 visitor arrived at 18:00 for the pork tenderloin katsu sandwich and found it already sold out.
A diner on a second visit in November 2026 called it a chic bistro in a back alley; on a July 2026 visit the same reviewer had worked through the whole menu in one day.
A June 2026 diner found the menu a little limited, though the space was calm and stylish.

kyoto_la_papaye_verte.gf_detail: Ask. Much of the menu is rice-based (pho, rice vermicelli, rice-paper spring rolls), but dishes are seasoned with Vietnamese soy sauce and nuoc mam and there are battered frogs’ legs, egg noodles and fried spring rolls; no gluten information is published (official site).
kyoto_la_papaye_verte.vegan_detail: Not vegan: nuoc mam seasons many dishes, and the menu is built on pork, beef, chicken, shrimp, crab and fish (official site). Water spinach with garlic and green papaya salads are listed, but no vegan information is published.
kyoto_la_papaye_verte.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30), closing days not fixed (Tabelog). The official site gives lunch as 12:00–14:00, dinner 17:30–23:00, open every day but sometimes closed for holidays. Reservations taken; same-day bookings by 14:30 (Tabelog). Courses for two or more; banquets up to 30; the nabe courses and course menus for four or more by phone booking (official site). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog); reviewers in January 2025 and July 2025 left exact money on the table or counter. 22 seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). kyoto_la_papaye_verte.notes: [Vietnamese · Karasuma-Oike, a silent one-man kitchen] A long-running Vietnamese restaurant off Anekoji where one owner cooks and serves almost without a word: generous plate lunches with free self-service juices, pho and bun bo Hue, and a dinner menu of spring rolls, green papaya salads, banh xeo, tamarind crab and herbal hot pots. Reviewers say to read up first, find your own seat and bring exact change: cash only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction describes a Vietnamese restaurant run by a French-trained chef, known for a herbal hot pot of beef tendon with lemongrass, yuba, thick fried tofu, lotus root and bean sprouts. Reviewers describe a male owner who seemed to run the place alone (February 2020) and who handled both the kitchen and the floor alone (July 2025). Almost every review mentions the near-silent service: menus taken away without a word, food set down in silence, no greeting at the door (February 2020; January, May and July 2025; March 2026); others found the owner reserved but quick to take orders, with a sincere "thank you" at the end (August 2025), and a regular-filled room where little needed saying (August 2026). A December 2024 visitor met an imposing owner who resembled Steven Seagal, found the atmosphere like a silent film, and called the flavour, portions, presentation and service all excellent. A March 2026 diner saw the owner carefully wiping tables with alcohol and checking the drinks station, and thought the owner perhaps just shy. An April 2025 reviewer called it a place that has been around a long time.
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy plates rich in herbs and vegetables alongside hearty dishes of authentic ingredients, in full or half portions (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Plate lunch; pho; herbal hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A February 2020 diner watched a group waiting to pay be passed over while the owner first took a newcomer’s order; a regular told the group one must wait if change is needed.

An April 2025 regular dipped a spring roll in the small sauce meant for the fried rice, and the owner hurried over: that sauce is for the fried rice. The same reviewer had lately seen a cat wandering around the restaurant.
A July 2025 diner, unable to pay face to face while the owner stayed in the kitchen, waited a few minutes and left the money on the counter, and advises having exact change ready.
A November 2024 family who walked in knowing nothing were startled by the self-service drinks and the service, then found the beef pho better than one eaten in Vietnam.

kyoto_bagel_kun_to_oden_chan.notes: [Oden · Shinmachi-Bukkoji, bagels and French oden] A ten-seat evening bar where a pastry chef pairs chewy rice-flour bagels, steamed to order, with oden two ways: classic in a seafood broth, or "French" with porcini, basil or white sauce and cheese. Bagel sandwiches, oden-broth obanzai and fruit sours. Opened May 2025; cards and PayPay.

chef_bio.background: A May 2025 reviewer says the shop is run by a pastry chef and recommends the owner’s madeleines and other baked sweets. Tabelog’s invoice number T6130001067508 is registered to 株式会社ＫＡＧＵＹＡ　ＦＯＯＤＳ (カグヤフーズ), with an office on Shijo-dori in Shimogyo Ward (NTA register). A May 2026 reviewer, back after a long gap, describes a young, very capable new owner, and says the Japanese-style oden uses fish cakes from a maker that supplies only four shops in Kyoto. A May 2025 visitor who wanted a softer daikon was told others had said the same and that it would be made softer.
chef_bio.specialty: Steamed rice-flour bagels; French oden such as daikon with porcini sauce.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner, wondering whether this was just a trend-chasing combination, found the steamed bagel so chewy it seemed more like mochi, and advises two plates of bagels per person.

A September 2026 bagel lover came late and found only half the bagels left.
A January 2026 diner rated the daikon with porcini sauce the best of the night, but found the konnyaku short on flavour and preferred the bagel plain to dipped in broth.

kyoto_teppan28_omiya.notes: [Takoyaki and wine · Shijo-Omiya, a teppan wine bar] Takoyaki, blue-cheese negiyaki and yakisoba carbonara alongside pâté, duck and venison, with over 100 wines and a ¥500 appetizer plate; the owner talks wine and runs blind tastings. chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a wine bar "run by a wine enthusiast" (November 2025) and a "passionate owner offering blind tastings" (September 2024); a November 2025 reviewer writes that acing the blind tasting can earn a free meal or a bottle of high-end wine. kyoto_ashibe_gojo_omiya.gf_detail: Ask: the cakes are tarts, sponge and dacquoise cakes (2026 reviews), and the snacks include deep-fried broccoli and cauliflower with Parmigiano (December 2025); no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_ashibe_gojo_omiya.vegan_detail: Ask: bean sprout namul and snap peas with miso mayonnaise are on the snack board (June 2026), but the cakes use cream and the snacks include goma saba (mackerel) (December 2025); no vegan option stated.
kyoto_ashibe_gojo_omiya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sun 13:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); may close early once the cakes sell out; cards (Visa, AMEX) only for ¥5,000 or more; e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). kyoto_ashibe_gojo_omiya.notes: [Cake and wine · Omiya-dori by Gojo, a cake shop and standing bar] A couple's small shop: the owner's wife bakes cakes meant to go with wine, the owner cooks the snacks, and you can drink, eat cake with coffee, or take cakes home. chef_bio.background: An August 2025 reviewer writes that the cakes are made "by the pastry chef, who is also the owner's wife", and that "the snacks prepared by the husband were also meticulously crafted"; a September 2025 visitor describes "a stylish spot run by a couple that feels like a café and a standing bar at the same time". Reviewers find it hard to say whether it is a cake shop that serves wine or a wine bar that sells cakes (February 2026; January 2026), and describe it as packed with drinkers just after 7 PM (February 2026), a place where other customers drink during the day (June 2026), comfortable for solo visits (March 2026), and popular with families picking up cakes (August 2022). A September 2026 regular often finds it closed or the cakes sold out.
chef_bio.specialty: Cakes made to go with wine; snacks.

anecdotes.text: August 2025: "I enjoyed it with red wine, and the balance of sweetness and subtle bitterness was exquisite, making it truly enjoyable with the wine."

kyoto_tsunku_shichijo.notes: [Yakiniku · Shichijo-dori near Kyoto Station, a charcoal wagyu grill] Kuroge wagyu from the Kyoto butcher 銀閣寺大西 grilled over charcoal, horumon, yukhoe and meat sushi, with courses from ¥4,700 and all-you-can-drink. Counter at the front, semi-private rooms behind. Adults only (20+); smoking allowed. Open from 16:00, from 11:30 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: The shop's Tabelog page says the meat comes from the long-established Kyoto butcher 銀閣寺大西 and that the owner buys seafood directly at the Kyoto Central Market; gurunavi gives the same supplier ("『銀閣寺大西』から仕入れている絶品のお肉") and says the shop has an affiliated bar ("系列店にBARがございます"). Opened 1 December 2021 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a clean, modern Japanese room (December 2025; March 2026), seats set in pairs at the counter (December 2025), a stylish semi-private room (November 2026), and a place that suits parties (August 2025; January 2026). Some found the service poor: staff chatting within earshot (March 2025), "the service was not very good" (July 2025), and a slow first round of drinks at a large party (January 2026). Two reviewers found the meat and value average and the platter pieces small (January, August 2026); others praise the value (August 2025; March 2026).

kyoto_sumibi_yakitori_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakitori with salt or a sweet-savoury tare, plus side dishes such as offal yakisoba and cheese-fried gyoza; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_yakitori_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu is built on chicken; corn butter is the one vegetable dish reviewers name, and nothing is described as vegan.
kyoto_sumibi_yakitori_marutamachi.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Card accepted (AMEX listed) (Tabelog). No private rooms (Tabelog). Takeout: the yakitori rice bowl from one order and yakitori from five skewers (February 2025). About 400 m from Marutamachi station (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumibi_yakitori_marutamachi.notes: [Charcoal yakitori · Marutamachi, open to midnight] A small, clean yakitori bar, new when first reviewed in December 2022, grilling over charcoal until midnight six nights a week. Reviewers like the skin, tsukune, juicy breast and low-temperature liver, the manager’s seasoning, and the offal yakisoba; sake tastings, children welcome, and yakitori bowls to take away. Service can be slow when one person runs it alone.

chef_bio.background: A newly opened shop in December 2022 and January 2023 reviews. In January 2023 the manager was running everything alone and orders were slow; a March 2024 regular praises the manager’s seasoning of the gizzard and the polite, attentive service, and a February 2024 regular calls it comfortable alone or with children, with friendly staff. One February 2024 diner was disappointed when the mayonnaise was cleared before the quail bacon was finished.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal yakitori; offal yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: A December 2022 diner in the mood for yakitori dropped in, surprised to find a yakitori shop there, and found the negima had hardly any green onion but the skin delicious.
A February 2025 diner who took the yakitori home found it good even cold.

kyoto_yoshoku_hamburg_kojinguchi.notes: [Yoshoku lunch house · Kojinguchi, one-person kitchen] A small, café-like Western-style restaurant at Kawaramachi-Kojinguchi, opened in 2022, where the young owner cooks alone and shapes each hamburg steak by hand. Students and elderly local couples at lunch (March 2026); orders take a little time.

kyoto_cafe_bal_cercle_nanajo.notes: [Café and bar · north of Kyoto Station, eight seats] A narrow townhouse café behind a turquoise awning near Nishinotoin-Nanajo, open since 2023; an October 2024 reviewer found the owner, a woman, running it alone. kyoto_pouka_cookie_shop_kojinguchi.notes: [Cookie shop · Kojinguchi, takeaway] A small, retro-feeling cookie specialist a few steps east of Kawaramachi, with rows of bagged cookies — plain butter cookies, mugwort, white miso, yuba, Kyoto-vegetable mixes — and a few chiffon cakes. Made with domestic flour and butter and no additives (own site). A series without butter or white sugar includes a wheat-free chickpea cookie; the buckwheat and oatmeal cookies list no animal ingredients. Gift boxes; a second shop in Miyama.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Every other cookie and cake on the own site lists wheat flour (国産小麦粉 or 全粒粉); the site says nothing about separate equipment or packing for the wheat-free cookie.

vegan_cross_contact.text: The buckwheat and oatmeal cookies list no animal ingredients but are not labelled vegan; most other cookies use butter and eggs (own site).

positives.text: ひよこ豆クッキー (¥640): listed as made without wheat, sugar, butter or egg; ingredients chickpea flour, honey, walnuts, raisins, rice oil, chocolate, soy milk, white sesame, baking powder.
The shop describes its 想いやり cookie series as including gluten-free and sugar-free cookies, without preservatives, synthetic additives, butter or white sugar.

existence.note: Own site (copyright 2012–2026) and Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); reviews dated July 2023 to September 2026.

kyoto_kissa_senrin_shogoin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the lunches centre on fried foods — shrimp fry, fried oysters, kara-age — with hamburg steak, curry, yakisoba and pasta (2014–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_senrin_shogoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set meals of grilled meat, hamburg steak and fried seafood with miso soup (2014–2025 reviews); no plant-based dish is described.
kyoto_kissa_senrin_shogoin.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 10:00–20:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). No credit cards or e-money (Tabelog; QR payment not stated). 37 seats: 7 at the counter, seven tables for four and one for two, with bench seats along the wall (Tabelog). Smoking allowed throughout (Tabelog; 2020–2025 reviews). Parking for one car, paid parking nearby; take-out (Tabelog). A sign at the entrance said "one-person operation", and the B set comes out faster than à la carte dishes (February 2023). About 670 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kissa_senrin_shogoin.notes: [Kissa · Shogoin, big set lunches in a Showa-era coffee shop] A long-running Showa-style coffee shop run by one person, with a long lunch board: grilled meat and shrimp fry sets for about ¥850, fried oysters in season, curry and yakisoba, all in large portions. Smoking allowed throughout; no cards. Monday–Saturday 10:00–20:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a long-standing coffee shop in Shogoin, Sakyo — a February 2023 diner guessed twenty or thirty years or more — with a counter and box seats in an old-school kissa room (September 2014) that a June 2019 diner likened to a student café, spacious and busy around 1 pm. A sign at the entrance read "one-person operation" in February 2023; that diner described the owner as a younger man, perhaps in the thirties, quick and responsive, but found the area around the stove grimy. A November 2023 visitor found the master laid-back and quite unique, noting that some online reviewers had found the master difficult. Reviewers praise the cheap, generous portions (2014–2025) and fault the smoke (2020; December 2021; 2023; October 2025); a May 2018 diner blamed poor frying oil for an upset stomach and found the rice sticky, a September 2014 diner found the steak dry and the rice partly mushy, and a December 2021 diner thought the food mediocre.
chef_bio.specialty: Set lunches of grilled meat and fried seafood.

anecdotes.text: An October 2018 diner, stuck for choice, took the mixed set and found a thin but very meaty hamburg steak hiding under the fried egg — then watched someone else’s yakisoba go by and vowed to order it next time.
In September 2020, after a meeting ran until nearly 3 pm, a diner came in for the first fried oysters of the season and sat as far from the smokers as possible.
An October 2025 visitor swapped shrimp fry for a companion’s kara-age and declared the kara-age the best dish.

kyoto_yocchan_marutamachi_kamanza.gf_detail: Ask. The only lunch is a wheat-udon set with tempura (2023–2025 reviews), so lunch is not gluten-free; at dinner there is sashimi alongside tempura and fried shrimp (2025–2026 reviews), with no gluten information.
kyoto_yocchan_marutamachi_kamanza.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the lunch udon comes in a katsuo dashi broth (December 2023), and dinner centres on fish and seafood from Tango (2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yocchan_marutamachi_kamanza.hours_raw: Lunch from 11:00 (end time not given) and dinner 17:00–24:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Which days lunch is served is not stated; structured hours show dinner only. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at an L-shaped counter around the kitchen and 12 at tables (Tabelog; June 2024); tables may be shared at lunch (June 2024). Smoking allowed; no parking; private hire possible (Tabelog). On Marutamachi-dori at the prefectural office corner, 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2024).
kyoto_yocchan_marutamachi_kamanza.notes: [Izakaya · Marutamachi, opposite the prefectural office, Tango fish and a ¥500 lunch] A twenty-seat izakaya run by an owner from the Tango Peninsula: fresh Tango fish and vegetables with Kyotango sake at night, and at lunch a single ¥500 udon set with tempura and a rice ball that fills the room. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.origin: Tango Peninsula, Kyoto Prefecture (September 2024; August 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: an izakaya on Marutamachi-dori at the prefectural office corner, across from the Second Red Cross Hospital (August 2026), serving fish, vegetables and sake from Tango. The owner, from Tango, runs the place alone, checking with lunch guests about sharing tables (June 2024), and has a down-to-earth manner (September 2024); an August 2026 diner said the owner had caught the squid on the platter. The ¥500 lunch draws office workers and hospital visitors (March 2024) and was nearly full with quick turnover in October 2025; reviewers liked the broth but a December 2023 diner found the udon noodles like cheap supermarket ones, and a September 2024 diner likened the set to a staff meal.
chef_bio.specialty: Tango fish and sake; the ¥500 udon lunch.

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 diner on the way to a nearby hospital tried the ¥500 udon, praised the rich katsuo broth, and resolved to come back for the izakaya at night.
In June 2024 a diner ordered the udon cold, bukkake style, and decided the hot version, which most others chose, would have been easier to eat.
On a first dinner in August 2026, a diner found the owner-caught squid sweet and was most impressed by the fish.

kyoto_natural_cafe_kyoto_ekimae.gf_detail: Ask. The signature is a cream-filled donut made from wheat dough fermented for a day, with panini alongside (official site); the taco rice and gapao rice plates are rice dishes, but no gluten or allergen information is given (official site, 2026-11-26).
kyoto_natural_cafe_kyoto_ekimae.vegan_detail: Ask. Soy milk and oat milk can be swapped into drinks for +¥50 (official site), but the donuts are filled with Hokkaido fresh cream or custard (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) and the rice plates have meat and egg (November 2026); no vegan food is described.
kyoto_natural_cafe_kyoto_ekimae.hours_raw: Daily 8:00–20:00; donuts from 11:00 until sold out; no regular closing day (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 78 seats (Tabelog; the official site says 80 in one place and 70 in another), including counter seats with power outlets, sofas and free Wi-Fi; children, babies and strollers welcome; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking (official site; Tabelog). Choose a seat, then order at the counter (October 2026; January 2026). English menu; take-out (Tabelog). Opened 21 March 2025 (Tabelog). 3 min walk from the Karasuma Central Exit of JR Kyoto Stn, near Kyoto Tower (Tabelog).
kyoto_natural_cafe_kyoto_ekimae.notes: [Café · in front of Kyoto Stn, cream donuts and coffee in a big green room] A large, bright café three minutes from Kyoto Station’s Karasuma exit, with plants, wood and big windows: cream-filled donuts from ¥300 (from 11:00), good coffee, taco rice and panini. Order at the counter; outlets and Wi-Fi; strollers welcome. Daily 8:00–20:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: opened in March 2025 in the Kyoto Ekimae Building; the invoice holder on Tabelog (T9130001069468) is 枳殻邸別館株式会社 of Shimogyo, Kyoto (NTA register). The site presents a spacious, work-friendly café near Kyoto Station, its donuts made with carefully chosen flour and Hokkaido fresh cream. Reviewers describe a bright, spacious room with well-spaced tables, plants, wood and natural light (2026), busy on weekend afternoons with people working or studying (October 2026) and many families with small children (May 2026). A January 2026 diner was not told to order at the counter, waited at the table, and was handed water in a small paper cup in an unfriendly way; an October 2026 diner found the staff very kind. An October 2026 diner found the tomato panini cold, and another found the espresso small.
chef_bio.specialty: Cream-filled donuts; coffee.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor who never pays more than ¥500 for coffee hesitated at the prices, then ordered one anyway for the calm room — and urged others to see the restroom.
In October 2026 a diner paid with au PAY from a shareholder benefit for a whipped-cream donut and espresso.
On a fourth visit in October 2026 a diner found the tomato panini cold but the coffee delicious, with a nice acidity; in February 2026 the same diner had called it a favourite coffee of late.

kyoto_sakaba_hattari_fukumoto.gf_detail: Ask. Specialities are straw-grilled bonito tataki, sashimi and homemade tofu (Tabelog), with fried dishes such as a rare tuna cutlet alongside (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_sakaba_hattari_fukumoto.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu centres on fish, but there is tofu made each morning from house soy milk (Tabelog) and a variety of vegetable dishes (October 2026); no vegan dish is described.
kyoto_sakaba_hattari_fukumoto.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 16:00–23:00; last order 22:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog) and advised — reviewers found it full without one (May 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: 11 at the counter and a raised table for 4 on the ground floor; one tatami room for 4 and two for 6 upstairs, where groups up to 16 can be seated and the floor can be hired privately (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair users are asked to consult in advance; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog). No parking; coin parking next door (Tabelog). 10 min walk from Kyoto Stn, across Shichijo-dori (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_sakaba_hattari_fukumoto.notes: [Izakaya · north of Shichijo near Kyoto Stn, straw-grilled bonito in a machiya] A thirty-seat izakaya in an old machiya ten minutes from Kyoto Station: Kochi bonito seared in straw flames at the counter, fresh tuna, homemade tofu and a long sake list. Book ahead; English menu. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: the Tabelog invoice number T2810436213180 is registered to 服部 祐介 (NTA register, from 1 January 2025). Tabelog describes a nostalgic space renovated from a Kyoto machiya, with sake picked by the manager. An April 2026 diner understood that the owner does all the cooking, so food comes slowly while drinks come quickly, and felt the owner’s dedication throughout; a June 2026 diner sat in a small raised area by the entrance with walls papered in old newspapers, and noted the place is little known because it is across Shichijo-dori from the station. Reviewers praise the fish and the reasonable drink prices (2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-grilled bonito tataki.

anecdotes.text: In May 2026 a diner phoned and was told it was full, then got a call back ten minutes later offering two counter seats; the companion kept saying how good the bonito was.
A May 2026 diner who had failed to drop in several times without booking finally sat at the counter to watch the straw grilling.
A regular dinner group of friends and spouses came in October 2026 for the return of bonito season and ordered two plates of tataki.

kyoto_furusato_shijo_omiya.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. The board has many fried dishes and tempura — fried shrimp, kara-age, whitebait and conger-eel tempura, fried sweet shrimp — as well as sashimi and grilled fish (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_furusato_shijo_omiya.vegan_detail: Vegan — ask: no vegan claim. The menu leans to seafood and meat, and the ¥300 appetizer served to everyone was a chilled conger-eel dish in July 2026; reviewers also had spicy pickled eggplant, aged pickles and a celery salad, ingredients not stated (2026 reviews).
kyoto_furusato_shijo_omiya.hours_raw: Every day 17:00–01:20; closed the first and third Sundays of the month; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations taken (Tabelog); reviewers advise phoning ahead — the shop was full by 18:00 in January 2026 and fully booked in March 2026, early-evening bookings are hard to get and there is no time limit, so the shop calls back when a seat frees up (December 2025); a 22:45 booking was welcomed in October 2026. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥300 (Tabelog: 「お通し300円」). 26 seats: 10 at the counter, 16 on tatami; private hire possible; smoking allowed; no parking (Tabelog). On the 3rd floor of 鳥居ビル, by lift, directly connected to Exit 3 of Hankyu Omiya Station (Tabelog; February 2024 and December 2025 reviews).
kyoto_furusato_shijo_omiya.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Omiya] A retro Showa-era izakaya up a lift on the 3rd floor right above Hankyu Omiya Station: a long whiteboard of fresh sashimi (an 11-kind platter for ¥1,800 in 2025), tempura, fried shrimp and seasonal small plates, plus whole-fruit cocktails and a tomato highball. Popular and often full — phone ahead. Cash only; open to 01:20; closed the 1st and 3rd Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A long-established Kyoto izakaya, in a July 2026 reviewer’s words, with a retro, Showa feel (February 2024, May and September 2026). A regular who made at least four visits in 2026 writes of the warm smiles and chat of the owner and the proprietress, who make it feel like coming home (July 2026). An April 2026 diner watched three staff serve a nearly full room quickly; a July 2026 diner found the staff kind. A February 2026 diner found a woman on the staff — perhaps the owner, the reviewer guessed — quite unfriendly, and the chef much kinder, while praising the food and prices and noting many repeat customers.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi and fried dishes from a long whiteboard; whole-fruit cocktails.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular at the counter saw the diner alongside with a beautifully plated yokowa sashimi, ordered the same, and was glad of it.
A May 2026 regular got a little loud after a few drinks and was asked to keep it down — and took it as a sign of being a regular.
An October 2026 diner booked for 22:45 after work, was welcomed warmly, and called the fresh tomato highball the best in Japan.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ふる里、居酒屋、阪急大宮駅すぐ、毎日17:00〜翌1:20、第1・第3日曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、お通し300円、26席 (カウンター10席、座敷16席)、喫煙可、駐車場なし。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 昭和レトロな居酒屋、ホワイトボードの品書き、刺身盛り合わせ1,800円、果物を丸ごと使ったフルーツカクテル、トマトハイボール、電話予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: No English evidence found; the menu is a handwritten whiteboard that one reviewer found hard to read (December 2025), and Tabelog warns phone service may be Japanese only. Booking is by phone.

kyoto_mark_shogoin.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Daily sets often include fried chicken, croquettes or tempura-style broccoli, and the menu has pasta, pita sandwiches and scones (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_mark_shogoin.vegan_detail: Vegan — ask: no vegan claim. The daily set changes each day and usually centres on meat or seafood with an egg-and-cheese omelette; a soy-milk soup came with corn and egg (July 2024). Vegetable side dishes and salads are plentiful, ingredients not stated (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_mark_shogoin.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:00), Sunday 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Tabelog also notes that reservations can be made until 15:00 on the day (courses a day ahead) and that it then opens until 23:00 (last order 22:00); a June 2025 diner was told the shop mainly serves lunch and takes dinner by reservation only, with a 7-dish omakase course for ¥3,000 including tax and dessert. Lunch fills soon after noon and daily-set dishes can sell out by about 13:00 (July 2023, April 2024). Cards (AMEX), e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog); PayPay (March 2023). No service charge (Tabelog). 32 seats on two floors, sofas upstairs; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; no parking (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). Opened 8 August 2003 (Tabelog). Under 5 minutes’ walk east of Jingu-Marutamachi Station, 1 minute from the “Kumano Shrine” city bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_mark_shogoin.notes: [Café · Shogoin, near Kyoto University Hospital] A spacious, stylish café in a renovated old house on the lane south of Kyoto University Hospital, open since 2003: a ¥900 daily set of three side dishes, salad, soup and a big bowl of rice, Asian-leaning rice plates and curries, scones and parfaits, with sofas upstairs. Dinner courses by reservation. Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.background: Opened 8 August 2003 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a café renovated from an old traditional house (June 2025), roomier inside than it looks, with a high-ceilinged second floor and large sofas (April 2024, October 2025), relaxed background music (2023–25), and staff who adjust the rice to each diner (July 2024). A June 2025 family was greeted “we’ve been expecting you” for a private party, and the staff said researchers from the nearby hospital labs come for lunch and book dinners. An October 2026 diner saw many staff and visitors from Kyoto University Hospital.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily set of three dishes; Asian-leaning rice plates.

anecdotes.text: A November 2023 diner asked for a little less rice and still got a mountain of it — then heard the staff double-check “a little less, right?” before it came out.
At a June 2025 private family dinner, the children made a game of guessing the titles of the unusual background music.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: マーク、カフェ・食堂、京阪神宮丸太町駅から東へ徒歩5分以内、市バスの熊野神社のバス停から徒歩1分、月〜土11:00〜20:00 (LO19:00)、日曜11:00〜17:00 (LO16:00)、不定休、当日15時までの予約で23:00 (LO22:00) まで営業 (コースは前日まで)、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、サービス料なし、32席、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可、駐車場なし、オープン2003年8月8日。口コミ (2021年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 900円の日替わり定食、ご飯は大盛り、グリーンカレー950円、インドネシア風そぼろご飯、メロンパフェ650円、夜は予約制の7品のおまかせコース3,000円、京大病院の近く。

cultural_comfort.note: No English evidence found; Tabelog warns phone service may be Japanese only. Order the daily set and say if you want less rice.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_chukoen_shiokoji.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Ramen, Tianjin noodles and dandan noodles are wheat noodles, the set side dishes have included dumplings and chijimi, and yurinchi and kara-age are fried (2019–26 reviews).
kyoto_chukoen_shiokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the set soup is a chicken-stock and egg soup, and the mains reviewers describe are meat or egg dishes — sweet-and-sour pork, yurinchi, crab omelette, Tianjin rice (2019–26 reviews). No vegan claim.
kyoto_chukoen_shiokoji.hours_raw: Lunch only, 11:00–14:00; closed Wednesday and Saturday (shop’s blog notice: open again from 1 April 2025; Tabelog the same, open on public holidays). The blog notice also says the Chinese head chef is absent for the time being, so the shop asks guests to come for set meals, ramen and fried rice at lunch (set ¥1,200, ramen and fried rice ¥950 each). Order and pay at the register first, then take a cup and sit; rice refills free (May 2025, 2019). Banquets by reservation; private hire for 4 or more; bookings on closing days negotiable (Tabelog; blog). Seats: 20 (Tabelog); up to 16, 5 tables and 4 at the counter (blog). Tabelog marks it non-smoking; the blog’s shop page says smoking allowed. No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). No parking; the pay car park north of the shop closed at the end of February 2024, bicycles and motorbikes can stop in front (blog). The 塩小路高倉 city bus stop is right in front (buses 16, 205, 81, special 81); 15 minutes’ walk from Kyoto Station, 441 m from Keihan Shichijo (blog; Tabelog).
kyoto_chukoen_shiokoji.notes: [Chinese · east of Kyoto Station] A homely Chinese lunch shop by the 塩小路高倉 bus stop, 15 minutes’ walk east of Kyoto Station: order and pay at the register, then sweet-and-sour pork, yurinchi or Tianjin rice as a set with soup, small dishes and free rice refills (about ¥950–1,200). Lunch only, 11:00–14:00; closed Wednesday and Saturday.

roles: cook 彭 (ホウ), per the shop’s blog — absent for now (2025 notice)
chef_bio.background: The shop’s blog: it reopened after a renewal on 7 October 2011 as a Chinese restaurant with a new cook holding a national special-grade licence and over 20 years’ experience, while keeping the old 中光園 dishes for limited periods. The cook, 彭 (ホウ), is from Chongqing in Sichuan, is good at spicy food and eats it too, adjusts sweetness and heat to each guest, and also cooks Shanghai, Beijing and Cantonese dishes. The shop closed from 7 May 2022 and reopened on 1 March 2023 in a changed format; a later notice says it has been open since 1 April 2025, lunch only, with the Chinese head chef absent for the time being (blog). Reviewers: the owner asked how the meal was and invited a family back (May 2025); every staff member was relieved when a diner came back for a bag left behind, which the shop had kept safe (March 2026); a June 2023 diner found everything cold, and a May 2025 diner’s rice went cold while the yurinchi was still cooking.
chef_bio.philosophy: Adjusts sweetness and spice to each guest’s taste (shop’s blog).
chef_bio.specialty: Set meals — sweet-and-sour pork, yurinchi, Tianjin rice; Sichuan tantanmen (blog).

anecdotes.text: In March 2026 a diner left a bag behind, realised on the bus, phoned, and came back to find it kept safe and all the staff relieved.
A May 2025 family ordered a large yurinchi set to share with the child and were surprised the price stayed the same.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のブログ (中華美食店　中光園ホームページ): 2025年4月1日より営業、開店11:00〜14:00、定休日は水曜・土曜、当分は中国人料理長が不在、定食1200円、ラーメン・チャーハン各950円。2024年: 店舗北側の有料駐車場が2月末で閉鎖。2022年5月7日から休み、2023年3月1日に形態を変えて再開。2011年10月7日にリニューアルオープン、20年以上の調理経験を持つ国家認定特級の新しいコック。四川坦々麺、醤油ベースの中華そば、東坡肉麺、叉焼麺。料理人「彭 (ホウ)」は四川の重慶市出身、辛い料理が得意、お客様の好みに合わせて甘辛を調節、上海料理・北京料理・広東料理も。席数最大16席 (テーブル5、カウンター4)、喫煙可、4名以上で貸切可、京都駅から徒歩15分、店正面に市バス「塩小路高倉」。食べログ: 中華美食店 中光園、中華料理、月・火・木・金・日・祝日 11:00〜14:00、水・土休み、20席、禁煙、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2017年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 酢豚定食、油淋鶏定食、天津飯、天津麺、ご飯おかわり無料、先にレジで注文と支払い。

cultural_comfort.note: No English evidence found; the blog is in Japanese and Tabelog warns phone service may be Japanese only. Order and pay at the register before sitting down.

existence.note: Shop’s blog notice of reopening from 1 April 2025; Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sizuk_shichijo.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Mostly sake and shochu, with small snacks such as heshiko, grilled ray fin, plum kelp and meat-miso peppers (2025–26 reviews); craft beer is also sold (August 2026). How the snacks are seasoned is not stated.
kyoto_sizuk_shichijo.vegan_detail: Vegan — ask: no vegan claim. Snacks reviewers had are mostly fish or meat — heshiko, ray fin, meat miso — with a Kyoto eggplant dish in December 2025; ingredients not stated.
kyoto_sizuk_shichijo.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 15:00–24:00; closed Monday (official site; Tabelog; rurubu). Earlier hours were 11:00–20:00, to 24:00 on Fridays and Saturdays (Sake World, 2024), and a December 2025 reviewer notes it used to open at 11:00. A “senbero” deal until 18:00 (October 2026). A standing bar (Tabelog category). Reservations taken; take-out (Tabelog); bottles to take home (2025–26 reviews). Cards (AMEX), e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog). Opened November 2022 (Sake World). About 5 minutes from the Karasuma exit of JR Kyoto Station, on Shichijo-dori (Tabelog; December 2025 review).
kyoto_sizuk_shichijo.notes: [Sake bar · Shichijo, near Kyoto Station] A stylish neon-lit sake shop on Shichijo-dori, five minutes from Kyoto Station, with a standing counter: tell the staff what you like and get a flight of three sakes for ¥1,300, with small snacks like heshiko and grilled ray fin, then buy a bottle of your favourite to take home. Open 15:00–24:00; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Sake World (2024): director Kazuma Sasaki worked for about 15 years in Kyoto restaurants, started the MASU PROJECT to spread sake culture, takes part in the nationwide Sake Go-Around event held with Sake Day, visits every brewery the shop buys from, and opened SiZUK in November 2022 as a place where people can meet over sake; the director’s family runs a tuna shop at the Kyoto City Central Market, the source of some seasonal snacks; the shop holds sake events and study groups. The official site names the operator as HUG PROJECT＆Co. LLC. Reviewers describe a young owner (December 2025), an owner who picks sakes to each guest’s taste (October 2025, November 2026), knowledgeable staff (December 2025), a modern, neon-lit room with a slope leading inside (October 2025, November 2026), and many regulars who were friendly to a first-timer (November 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: “We want to create a place where you can meet people for drinks” (Sake World, 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Staff-chosen sake flights; bottles to take home.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor asked for local sakes and got a flight from one Kyoto brewery, liked the 2025 test brew best, and bought a bottle of it on the way out.
A June 2026 visitor with time to kill before leaving Kyoto Station had the bar almost alone and was told the crowd usually comes in the evening.

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has a line of English and an English-language Sake World interview covers the shop; no English service reported. Staff choose sakes from your stated preferences.

kyoto_yakiniku_tb26032961_jingu_marutama.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with sauce or salt, namul, yukgaejang soup and cold noodles to finish (Tabelog; March 2026 reviews); no gluten or allergy information on Tabelog.
kyoto_yakiniku_tb26032961_jingu_marutama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef and offal yakiniku restaurant (tongue, skirt, Chateaubriand, tripe, small intestine, pork belly; 2025–2026 reviews); no vegan option mentioned.
kyoto_yakiniku_tb26032961_jingu_marutama.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun 17:00–22:30; closed Thursdays, but open when Thursday is a public holiday (Tabelog). Reservations taken; often fully booked, so book early (July 2025, November 2025 and October 2026 reviews); a July 2025 diner booked by phone 30 minutes ahead, and a March 2026 walk-in was seated for about 50 minutes before the next booking. Private hire for 20–50 people; Tabelog gives ¥5,000 a head for private parties and groups of 30 or more by arrangement. All-you-can-drink course ¥6,600 tax included (Tabelog). Service charge: the shop's own text on Tabelog reads 特になし (nothing in particular). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 42 seats including a counter; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; no parking (Tabelog). English menu; BYO drinks and takeout listed (Tabelog). 1 min walk from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 11 July 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_tb26032961_jingu_marutama.notes: [Yakiniku · Jingu-Marutamachi] A busy 42-seat yakiniku and offal restaurant by Jingu-Marutamachi Stn, run by an owner with 32 years in the meat trade: Kyoto beef, rare cuts and horumon, explained cut by cut, at ¥5,000–8,000 a head. Families with small children welcome; book ahead. Closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: The shop's own text on Tabelog: run by a master with 32 years of experience across seven places, specialising in meat, who sources rare cuts through long-standing relationships. Opened 11 July 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe an owner who explains each dish (July 2025), and in March 2026 a very tall owner, over 190 cm, who was warm and gentle in manner.
chef_bio.philosophy: The shop's own text on Tabelog: confident in judging and handling meat, serving fresh, high-quality cuts at reasonable prices.
chef_bio.specialty: Bara Shabu; offal platters; rare cuts of Kyoto beef.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 family booked by phone 30 minutes ahead and parked bicycles in front; the place was full of regulars and families with infants, the staff handled small children with ease, and the owner, who looks intimidating, turned out to be friendly.
A July 2025 diner, used only to chain yakiniku, found the offal free of any smell even without sauce, but felt the staff were somewhat unfriendly and strict with first-timers.

After a concert at ROHM Theatre in March 2026, a diner who drove over without a booking was given about 50 minutes before the next reservation and finished with two large bowls of rice and oolong tea.
A March 2026 diner from out of town found the room packed mostly with locals and rated the Chateaubriand and premium tripe above expectations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 牛 こうの、焼肉・韓国料理・居酒屋、左京区東丸太町11-4、京阪「神宮丸太町駅」から徒歩1分。月火水金土日 17:00〜22:30、木曜休み (祝日は営業)。予約可、貸切20〜50名、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、42席 (カウンターあり)、禁煙、車椅子可、駐車場なし、英語メニューあり、持ち込み可、テイクアウト可。サービス料: 特になし。オープン 2019年7月11日。飲み放題つきコース6,600円 (税込)。店の紹介 (英訳): 肉を専門に32年の経験を持つ店主、希少部位、黒板の本日のおすすめ、ユッケジャンスープ、生ビール350円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 家族連れや常連で満席、予約は早めに、肉の説明が丁寧、ホルモン、シャトーブリアン、冷麺。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu available (Tabelog). Phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing with the shop's own text and course; reviews dated July 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_earth_kitchen_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Bento include deep-fried croquettes and a minced-meat cutlet, and the sides are seasoned with naturally brewed seasonings (official site); no gluten information. A low-allergy bento can be ordered ahead after consulting the shop (official site); a 2007 reviewer also noted allergy-friendly bento by advance order.
kyoto_earth_kitchen_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu marks vegetarian dishes (soy-milk croquette, bean and vegetable croquette, multigrain sorghum croquette, vegetable potato-salad croquette and a vegetable tofu burger; the last two also carry the egg mark), and says vegetarians can order those (official site). But the dashi is made from bonito flakes, dried sardines and kelp (official site), and the side dishes change daily, so ask which sides are free of fish stock and egg. A 2007 reviewer described vegetarian and vegan-friendly bento.
kyoto_earth_kitchen_marutamachi.hours_raw: Official site: 10:30–18:00, closed Saturdays, Sundays, public holidays and in summer (a summer closure notice was posted for 2026). Tabelog gives Mon–Fri 10:30–18:30. Mainly takeaway; a few seats inside: one table (April 2007 review), three eat-in seats (February 2024 review). The daily bento can sell out by noon (February 2024) and in the past the shop often sold out and closed by evening (April 2007). Eat within one hour of purchase (official site). Catering: party platters for 5 from ¥7,560 and feast bento from ¥1,600 for 5 or more, by advance order; 30 or more bento can be discussed for weekend events (official site). No cards or e-money (Tabelog; QR not stated). On Marutamachi-dori, three doors east of Exit 4 of Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (official site), next to the yakitori shop Torito (April 2007 review).
kyoto_earth_kitchen_marutamachi.notes: [Bento · Jingu-Marutamachi] A long-running organic bento shop on Marutamachi-dori by the Kamo River: ¥1,050 boxes of a main and three or four vegetable sides on low-pesticide organic rice, with vegetarian-marked croquettes and a vegetable tofu burger, a low-allergy bento to order ahead, and three seats to eat in. Weekdays only; closed weekends, holidays and in summer.

chef_bio.background: The operator writes its name あーすきっちんかんぱにー in the site footer (official site). Reviews go back to 2007; a 2008 reviewer found the shop easy to spot by the human-shaped sign out front, and a 2016 reviewer came after seeing the bento on community TV.
chef_bio.philosophy: The official site: 「自然の恵みをお弁当に詰めました。」 — gentle, handmade bento from carefully chosen ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Bento of the day; tofu hamburg; vegetarian croquettes.

anecdotes.text: An April 2007 diner, put off before by the shop selling out and closing early, finally tried the multigrain tofu hamburg bento (¥735) and recommended eating it by the Kamo River, as the shop had room for only one table.
A February 2016 diner counted out ¥699 for the daily bento and was told ¥755 at the register; the price shown had been before tax.
Arriving around noon on a weekday in February 2024, a diner found the daily bento sold out but got one of three eat-in seats for the tea-simmered free-range chicken bento.
A May 2026 diner was surprised the Japanese-style tofu hamburg bento came hot and fresh, and found the flavours gentle and comforting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: オーガニックお弁当 あーすきっちん。「自然の恵みをお弁当に詰めました。」 お米は低農薬有機米、旬の無 (低) 農薬野菜、安全なお肉、お魚、平飼卵、国産大豆天然にがり豆腐、自然醸造の調味料、お出汁は鰹節、煮干し、昆布などの天然の素材から。手作り、合成保存料不使用。メインと野菜中心の副菜3〜4品、副菜は日替わり。メニューにベジタリアンと卵のマーク。お肉のお弁当、お魚のお弁当、コロッケのお弁当、七福 (野菜) 豆腐バーグ弁当 各1,050円、本日のお弁当1,030円、キーマカレー850円、各種おかずのみ930円、ミニおかず690円 (税込)。低アレルギーさん弁当は要相談。パーティー料理5人前7,560円から、ごちそう弁当1,600円から (5個以上)。AM10:30〜PM6:00、土曜・日曜・祝日と夏期休み。京阪「神宮丸太町駅」4番出口の東3軒目、左京区川端丸太町東丸太町9-7。事業者は あーすきっちんかんぱにー。食べログ: 月〜金 10:30〜18:30、カード・電子マネー不可。口コミ (2007〜2026年、英語): 菜食向けのお弁当、イートインの席3つ (2024年2月)、豆腐ハンバーグのお弁当1,050円 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese-only official site and menu; point-and-buy counter. Phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Official site with current prices and a 2026 summer closure notice; Tabelog listing; review dated May 2026.

kyoto_teahouse_tb26014037_kiyomizudera.gf_detail: Ask. Mitarashi dango in a sweet soy glaze, warabimochi and kakigori, plus udon and soba (2020–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_teahouse_tb26014037_kiyomizudera.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango, warabimochi, zenzai and matcha shaved ice are on the menu (2020–2026 reviews), but there is no ingredient information, the udon and soba come in broth, and some kakigori and the matcha latte use milk (October 2026 review).
kyoto_teahouse_tb26014037_kiyomizudera.hours_raw: Tabelog: 9:00 until sunset; closing days not fixed. No cards, e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). Inside the grounds of Kiyomizu-dera, on the path towards Chawan-zaka, a little back from the main route and quieter than the tea houses in front of it, with public toilets close by (November 2024, November 2025, February 2026 and October 2026 reviews); a September 2026 diner stopped here after climbing Chawan-zaka into the temple. Phone charging was available in October 2026 (review). The website Tabelog lists (www5e.biglobe.ne.jp/~rokkatei/) returned 404 in November 2026.
kyoto_teahouse_tb26014037_kiyomizudera.notes: [Tea house · Kiyomizu-dera] A small tea house inside the grounds of Kiyomizu-dera, set a little back on the path to Chawan-zaka and quieter than the approach: freshly grilled mitarashi dango, warabimochi, amazake, matcha kakigori and bowls of udon or soba, for under ¥1,000 at most visits. Open from 9:00 until sunset; cash only.

chef_bio.background: A tea house within Kiyomizu-dera's grounds (Tabelog address; March 2025 and September 2026 reviews). Reviewers note the prices are a little lower than usual for a tourist spot (May 2023) and reasonable (January 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Mitarashi dango; matcha kakigori.

anecdotes.text: A solo traveller in October 2020, during the main hall's renovation, had never liked warabimochi until trying the firm yet soft, gently sweet version here with matcha.
A May 2023 diner found it quiet, a little off the main route, and the udon good, though the staff were somewhat indifferent.
A diner who had loved the mitarashi dango years earlier came back in March 2025 and called it the best ever: freshly made, warm and chewy, with just the right grill marks.
In the heat of September 2026, with over 200 people queuing for temple stamps, a diner who had just climbed Chawan-zaka revived with a ¥700 matcha kakigori.

kyoto_style_coffee_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee, plus banana cake, apple and red-bean pies, muffins and weekend cinnamon rolls (2024–2026 reviews); no gluten or allergy information on the official site.
kyoto_style_coffee_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Drip coffee, espresso and cold brew are served alongside milk lattes (2023–2026 reviews); no plant milk or ingredient information for the cakes is given (official site; reviews).
kyoto_style_coffee_marutamachi.hours_raw: Official site: weekdays 8:30–17:00, weekends 9:00–17:00, closed Mondays and Fridays. Tabelog instead gives every day 9:00–17:00. No reservations; takeout (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). A small stand with a few chairs and a long bench but no tables (April 2024 and February 2025 reviews); a February 2025 reviewer called it a standing bar. Non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog). Ground floor of ペアリーフ御所東 on Kawaramachi-dori, about 5 min walk from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi Stn and 11 min from Marutamachi subway Stn (Tabelog). Opened 27 April 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_style_coffee_marutamachi.notes: [Coffee · Jingu-Marutamachi] A pared-back light-roast specialty coffee stand on Kawaramachi-dori near the Imperial Palace: single-origin drip, concentrated lattes, cold brew and espresso-and-soda drinks, beans to take home, and cakes and weekend cinnamon rolls. A few chairs, no tables. Closed Mondays and Fridays (official site).

roles: Owner (the seller named on the online shop's legal notice)
chef_bio.background: The legal notice of the shop's online store names the business as 黒須工 at the stand's address (official site). A February 2025 reviewer wrote that the owner came from WEEKENDERS COFFEE and that the stand had been recommended in a coffee book by the owner of ONIBUS. Opened 27 April 2019 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: The official site: high-quality coffee and knowledge, under three ideas — Face The Coffee (tasting by origin, farm and variety), Range Of Coffee (light roasting to show each bean's character, with tips for enjoying light roasts at home) and Sensory Lab (experiments, cuppings and workshops).
chef_bio.specialty: Light-roast single origins; iced caffe latte; weekend cinnamon rolls.

anecdotes.text: On a sweltering August 2024 day a diner, a little daunted by the stylish room and two handsome staff chatting, watched an iced latte poured at about 9.5 parts milk to 0.5 espresso and was amazed how strongly the coffee still came through.
A February 2025 diner praised the beans-first latte but, finding only chairs and nowhere to put a cup, asked for even a small table.

A regular of about ten visits wrote in July 2025 that the snacks and drinks had grown, praising a sudachi espresso soda, and in May 2026 the weekend cinnamon rolls; the reviewer preferred the red-bean pie to the sour apple pie.
A September 2025 diner liked the coffee, prices and clean shop but found the layout not very relaxing and the drinks slow, and suggested takeaway for a walk.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: STYLE COFFEE、上京区桝屋町360-1 ペアリーフ御所東1階。Open / Weekday 8:30-17:00、Weekend 9:00-17:00、Closed / Monday and Friday。浅煎り、Face The Coffee、Range Of Coffee、Sensory Lab。オンラインショップ: シングルオリジンの豆 (ホンジュラス、コスタリカ、エチオピア、ケニア、ブラジル)、ドリップバッグ、定期便。特定商取引法に基づく表記: 事業者の名称 黒須工。食べログ: コーヒースタンド、毎日 9:00〜17:00、予約不可、カード (JCB、AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、テイクアウト、オープン 2019年4月27日。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 浅煎りのスペシャルティコーヒー、カフェラテ500〜550円、水出しコーヒー500円、バナナケーキ350円、週末だけのシナモンロール、テーブルのない店内。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site partly in English, with hours given in English; friendly, courteous counter service (November 2023 and August 2024 reviews).

kyoto_orange_cafe_plus.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breakfast is toast, hot dogs, sandwiches and curry, and the lunch sets are built on tonkatsu, kara-age, shrimp tempura and katsu curry (September 2026 review). No gluten information is published.
kyoto_orange_cafe_plus.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the set lunches are pork steak, tonkatsu, kara-age, hamburg steak and omurice, served with miso soup (August and September 2026 reviews). No vegan information is published.
kyoto_orange_cafe_plus.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 07:30–15:00; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Breakfast from 07:30, lunch 11:00–15:00 (August 2026 review). Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cashless: cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog); an August 2026 diner was told cash is accepted for elderly people from the neighbourhood. 12 seats: 8 at the counter and 4 at tables (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner counted a counter, two tables for two and a table for four at the back. Orders can be placed at a touch panel by the entrance (September 2026). Non-smoking; no parking; children welcome; take-out (Tabelog). In KARASUMA STEPs, about 5 minutes from subway Gojo station (Tabelog), across from Shutoku Park (September 2026 review). Opened 13 August 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_orange_cafe_plus.notes: [Café · Shijo-Gojo, early breakfast and set lunches] A small new café opened in August 2026 between Shijo and Gojo, open from 07:30: toast, hot dogs and curry for breakfast, then ¥1,200 set lunches such as pork steak or a "grown-up kids’ lunch" plate of shrimp tempura, omurice, hamburg steak and kara-age. Cashless; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: An August 2026 diner, who asked a lot of questions, heard that the chef has long run a business independently. The shop opened on 13 August 2026 (Tabelog; August and September 2026 reviews). A September 2026 diner describes a warm, natural-wood interior. The Tabelog listing is the operator’s official listing; no website was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Set lunches; the lunch plate.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner came by just before noon, had the ¥1,200 pork steak set, found it substantial, liked the miso soup and stayed for a ¥350 coffee after walking in the heat.

A September 2026 diner called the lunch plate a "grown-up’s children’s lunch": a thin omelette over ketchup rice, a juicy hamburg steak, crisp kara-age, a large shrimp tempura and a generous salad with a dressing that seemed homemade, all for ¥1,200.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (英語版、公式情報): カフェ、予約可、火〜土7:30〜15:00、日・月定休、カード (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX、Diners、銀聯)・電子マネー・QRコード決済可、12席 (カウンター8席、テーブル4席)、全席禁煙、駐車場なし、テイクアウト可、子ども可、京都府京都市下京区徳万町202-4 KARASUMA STEPs 101、地下鉄五条駅から徒歩約5分、オープン日2026年8月13日。口コミ (2026年、英語): 朝食は7:30から、ランチは11:00〜15:00、トンテキの定食1,200円、食後のコーヒー350円、ランチと一緒なら飲み物200円引き、キャッシュレスだが近所のお年寄りは現金可 (2026年8月)。入口のタッチパネルでも注文可、朝はトースト、ホットドッグ、サンドイッチ、カレー、昼はランチプレート、トンテキ、とんかつ、唐揚げの定食、カツカレー、海老天、オムライス、ハンバーグ、唐揚げ、ポテトサラダのランチプレート税込1,200円 (2026年9月)。

kyoto_bistro_lest.gf_detail: Ask. Pâtés, terrines, confits, steaks and salads are on the menu, but so are fish and boar baked in pastry, a foie gras puff pastry and homemade bread (official take-out menu; reviews), and no gluten information is published. The kitchen is one chef.
kyoto_bistro_lest.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a French bistro menu of charcuterie, pâtés, game, duck, lamb, beef, fish and cheese (official take-out menu; reviews). A vegetable side platter is listed, but no vegan information is published.
kyoto_bistro_lest.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 15:00–21:45, last entry and orders 21:00 (official site; Tabelog gives 15:00–22:00, last order 21:00, course last order 20:30). Closed Mondays (Tabelog; the official site’s calendar); from 2026 also closed twice a month, with the dates posted on the official site (e.g. Tuesday 24 November and Tuesday 22 December 2026), regular opening again from New Year’s Day 2027. Reservations from one month ahead; bookings for any day other than today by phone after 20:00; parties of four or more book once numbers are fixed; call if more than about 15 minutes late; same-day cuts in party size without a call cost ¥2,000 a head; bookings through AutoReserve are all refused (official site). A December 2025 diner found phone booking hard. Cash only: no cards or payment apps (official site; June 2024 review). No service charge (Tabelog’s original text: なし). Four tables (October 2024 review). Non-smoking; no parking, coin parking nearby (Tabelog). Strongly scented fabric softener or perfume may mean refused entry; ask before photographing dishes, and no photos of half-eaten plates (official site). Take-out by phone at least 2 hours ahead, pick-up 15:00–20:00 (official site). About 5 minutes from Higashiyama station exit 2, on the west side of Higashioji just south of Nio-mon, four doors south of Hinode Tent, a black machiya with a small French flag (Tabelog; official site). Moved here from Teramachi Nijo (Tabelog); Tabelog gives the opening day as 29 May 2016.
kyoto_bistro_lest.notes: [French · Higashioji Nio-mon, a two-person bistro] A small French bistro in a black machiya on Higashioji, run by one chef in the kitchen and one madame on the floor: foie gras pudding, homemade charcuterie, fish and game in pastry, confits and stews, à la carte with French wine, from 15:00. Generous portions; leftovers can be taken home. Book by phone after 20:00; cash only; no strong perfume.

chef_bio.background: The official site says the restaurant has one chef cooking and one madame serving, and no other staff. Reviewers describe a couple running the restaurant (October 2024; April 2025), the madame giving helpful advice on what to order (July 2025), and the love of the chef and the madame in every detail (December 2025). A December 2025 diner praised the food as a level above other bistros and found the farewells exceptionally polite, but felt the female staff member’s tone was harsh and cold with customers who had walked into the wrong restaurant. Tabelog says the bistro moved from Teramachi Nijo to Higashioji Nio-mon; a September 2016 reviewer already found it about 10 minutes from Higashiyama station.
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras pudding; fish and game baked in pastry; homemade charcuterie.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 diner, back soon after a first visit, could not resist the rabbit galantine, warns that portions are generous, and notes that leftovers can be taken home.

An October 2024 diner, wary of game, found the venison tender and wondered whether one person really cooked everything; with only four tables, the reviewer read the size as the couple’s wish to look after each guest.
A January 2025 regular chose a day that looked quiet and still found the bistro fully booked.

An April 2025 group of three friends in kimono shared à la carte dishes and found them more than enough; another April 2025 diner thought of stopping by again after a concert at the nearby old Kyoto concert hall.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ビストロ　レスト (Bistro L'est)、フランス料理とフランスワイン、東大路仁王門下がる西側、黒い格子の町家、小さなフランス国旗が目印、15時開店〜21時45分閉店 (21時00分最終入店・注文受付)、2026年より月2回の休業日、2027年元旦から通常通り営業、調理はシェフ1人、サービスはマダム1人だけ、他にスタッフはいない、ご予約は同日の1ヵ月前から、当日以外のご予約は20時以降、4名以上は人数が確定してから、15分前後する際は電話、当日の人数減の連絡がない場合はお一人様2,000円のキャンセル料、AutoReserveからの予約はすべて断る、お支払いは現金のみ、香りの強すぎる柔軟剤や香水は入店を断ることがある、料理の写真は一声かけ、とりわけ後や食べかけは撮らない。お持帰りメニュー (税込、日付なし): パテ・ド・カンパーニュ1,000円、自家製シャルキュトリー5種盛り合わせ1,400円、フォアグラのテリーヌ2,100円、鮮魚のパイ包み焼き2,100円、牛ホホ肉の赤ワイン煮込み2,300円 (冷蔵真空パック)・2,700円 (温製)、仔羊のクスクス2,000円、鴨モモ肉のコンフィ1,400円、猪のパイ包み焼き2,100円、和牛のサーロインステーキ4,500円、チーズの盛り合わせ1,300円など、受取の2時間前までに電話で注文、お渡しは15時から20時。食べログ (英語版): ビストロ、予約可、火〜日15:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00、コースL.O.20:30)、月曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料なし、全席禁煙、駐車場なし (近くにコインパーキング)、寺町二条から東大路仁王門に移転、オープン日2016年5月29日。口コミ (英語): テーブル4卓、夫婦で営む (2024年10月)、満席 (2025年1月)、マダムのアドバイス (2025年7月)、電話予約が難しい、自家製パン、焼き菓子のお土産 (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone booking only (after 20:00 for later days), which a December 2025 diner found hard; no English menu or English-speaking staff mentioned in any source.
